tooltip.isekai_mahou.class_knight.outfit: Plain steel and a tabard bearing the sword and the runes.
Engraved silver: the arm runes already answer the blade.
White and gold of the Round Table; a lit rune rests on the chest.
A crown of runes above the helm. Whoever wears it has sworn every oath.
Full set: Defense %s · +%s Vigor · +%s Health · +%s melee damage
Full set (grade II+): Knight techniques +5%% (+10%% at IV).
tooltip.isekai_mahou.class_knight.runic_: Common steel with a rune groove. Holds two spells.
The groove deepens: three runes fit the blade.
Bluish steel that sings when a rune fires. Four slots.
White gold and winged guard: five runes, none wasted.
tooltip.isekai_mahou.class_knight.rune_e: No runes. Use the Engrave on Blade form.
tooltip.isekai_mahou.class_knight.rune_h: Each main hit (attack bar ≥ 70%%) fires the next engraved rune.
tooltip.isekai_mahou.class_knight.rune_c: Cost per rune strike: %s%% of the spell (half with Blade Aura).
tooltip.isekai_mahou.class_knight.rune_o: Oath IV: +1 rune slot on any blade.
tooltip.isekai_mahou.class_knight.legend: Echo: strikes may release a %s wave (35%% for Knights).
tooltip.isekai_mahou.class_knight.lake_e: Wielding it, the Excalibur form is 60%% stronger and wider.
glyph.isekai_mahou.knight_engrave.desc: Knight form: engraves the whole spell into the held sword. Each main hit fires the next rune (paying only part of the cost). Slots: plain sword 1, Runic Blade 2–5, Legendaries 4.
glyph.isekai_mahou.knight_sword_beam.des: Knight form: the swing releases an energy crescent that flies 22 blocks and cuts through up to 3 foes (+Pierce). Split fans it out; Expand widens it; works as a stage.
glyph.isekai_mahou.knight_rune_mark.desc: A light cut that brands a rune on the target. At 3 stacks (this spell or your sword hits) it ruptures: heavy damage, half around it, and Exposed.
glyph.isekai_mahou.knight_blade_aura.des: The blade is sheathed in light for 15 s: +3 melee damage per level, faster attacks and rune strikes at half cost. Invert: weakens the enemy.
glyph.isekai_mahou.knight_runic_thrust.d: Knight form: dash ~8 blocks forward with the blade extended, applying the effects to everyone passed through, ending with a ground strike.
glyph.isekai_mahou.knight_aegis.desc: Rune-stone plates orbit the target; each one negates a whole hit (2 +Amplify, 12 s). When the last breaks, the shards push enemies away.
glyph.isekai_mahou.knight_sword_rain.des: Knight form: a rune circle opens in the sky and spectral copies of your blade fall on the aimed spot (5 +2 per Split). Each sword is a copy of the effects.
glyph.isekai_mahou.knight_excalibur.desc: G form (ultimate): raise the blade and unleash a colossal 48-block beam of light that pulses 3 times. With the Sword of the Lake: 60%% stronger and wider.
A giant spectral sword falls on the target: heavy damage (×2.2 below 35%% health) and stuns for 1 s.
sword.isekai_mahou.class_knight.caliburn: Swear Oath II, defeat a boss and pull Caliburn from the altar's stone.
You and allies within 10 blocks gain Strength, Regeneration and Absorption; nearby foes are pushed.
allies within 8 blocks stand firm (Resistance I). Awakening unlocks the technique Caliburn — Sword of Selection.
tooltip.isekai_mahou.class_knight.calibu: The blade that chooses the king. They say whoever draws it never fights alone again.
sword.isekai_mahou.class_knight.flame.fe: With the Fire guardian's core and 40 Fire spell kills, temper the blade at the altar.
sword.isekai_mahou.class_knight.flame.ab: A fan of 5 flame waves that pierce and set ablaze.
Forged inside a lava dragon's chest. It is still warm.
sword.isekai_mahou.class_knight.storm.fe: With the Wind guardian's core and 40 Wind spell kills, awaken it during a thunderstorm (or with 2 lightning rods around the altar).
sword.isekai_mahou.class_knight.storm.ab: Up to 5 foes near the aimed point are struck by lightning and shocked.
Thunder obeys whoever raises it; the sky answers before the blow.
sword.isekai_mahou.class_knight.frost.fe: With the Water guardian's core and 40 Water spell kills, awaken it at an altar surrounded by 6 ice or snow blocks.
sword.isekai_mahou.class_knight.frost.ab: An ice ring bursts over 7 blocks: damage and Chilled; those already chilled freeze.
This blade's ice never melted, not even in the Nether.
sword.isekai_mahou.class_knight.dark.fea: After Oath III, with the Abyss Sovereign's core and 50 Shadow spell kills, awaken it at night. Shadow is hard for the Knight.
sword.isekai_mahou.class_knight.dark.abi: Foes within 8 blocks take Shadow damage and are blinded and corrupted; you heal 30%% of the damage.
sword.isekai_mahou.class_knight.dark.pas: night vision; echo strikes heal a little.
tooltip.isekai_mahou.class_knight.dark.l: It promises power to whoever breaks the oath. The Knight who masters it does not break.
sword.isekai_mahou.class_knight.lake.fea: After Oath IV, offer Caliburn, the Seraph's core and a Heart of the Sea at an altar surrounded by water (8 sources). Caliburn breaks and the lake returns the true blade.
sword.isekai_mahou.class_knight.lake.abi: A straight 32-block beam of light: Light damage and Exposed.
sword.isekai_mahou.class_knight.lake.pas: in water or rain your Vigor refills by itself. Awakening unlocks the technique Avalon — The Distant Sheath.
tooltip.isekai_mahou.class_knight.lake.l: Kept beneath the waters until the oath was worthy. Its light is Excalibur's.
site.isekai_mahou.class_knight.lake: altar surrounded by water (8 sources within 4 blocks)
site.isekai_mahou.class_knight.ice: altar surrounded by ice or snow (6 blocks within 3)
site.isekai_mahou.class_knight.storm: during a thunderstorm (or 2 lightning rods around)
oath.isekai_mahou.class_knight.1.desc: The first oath: the blade learns to hold magic. Show that you can engrave and fight.
oath.isekai_mahou.class_knight.1.reward: Blade Aura, Runic Charge and Invisible Air (Strike Air) · 3 Light Essences · XP
oath.isekai_mahou.class_knight.2.desc: Hundreds of runes released and eighty foes felled by the sword. The altar's stone begins to yield: Caliburn awaits.
oath.isekai_mahou.class_knight.2.reward: Runic Aegis, Sword Rain and Anti-Magic Blade · Runic Blade II · XP
oath.isekai_mahou.class_knight.3.desc: A boss defeated and a legendary sword in hand: the Knight takes a seat at the Table and learns the light that cuts fate.
oath.isekai_mahou.class_knight.3.reward: EXCALIBUR (G form) · Runic Blade III · XP
oath.isekai_mahou.class_knight.4.desc: Two swords awakened and three bosses defeated. The blade gains one more slot and judgment falls from the sky.
oath.isekai_mahou.class_knight.4.reward: Oath's Judgment and Balmung · +1 rune slot on every blade · Runic Blade IV · XP
oath.isekai_mahou.class_knight.5.desc: Four legendary swords and six bosses defeated. The Rune Crown weighs on whoever deserves it.
oath.isekai_mahou.class_knight.5.reward: Runic Crown: Knight techniques +15%% and +2 Armor with a sword · 8 Mana Crystals · 3 legends: Avalon, Balmung and Black Anti-Magic Cut · XP
message.isekai_mahou.class_knight.engrav: Rune engraved: %s (slot %s/%s) — the oldest rune faded
No sword in hand: the rune only lasts for your next strike.
message.isekai_mahou.class_knight.rune_i: The rune %s failed (forgotten glyph or Circle too low).
message.isekai_mahou.class_knight.altar_: Only a Rune Knight can swear oaths at this altar.
message.isekai_mahou.class_knight.oath_m: You have sworn every oath. Awaken the swords still missing.
message.isekai_mahou.class_knight.oath_t: See your progress in the Oaths tab (B key).
message.isekai_mahou.class_knight.sword_: %s wants to awaken, but the place is not right: %s.
message.isekai_mahou.class_knight.lake_l: Caliburn shatters on the stone... and from the waters a hand offers the true blade.
message.isekai_mahou.class_knight.outfit: Circle %s reached: you received the %s armor!
The pieces were equipped (the old ones went to your inventory).
The pieces are in your inventory.
screen.isekai_mahou.class_knight.title: Rune Knight Oaths
screen.isekai_mahou.class_knight.rank_no: No oath yet — the Oath Altar is in your kit.
screen.isekai_mahou.class_knight.only_kn: Only the Rune Knight swears oaths: engraves spells into the sword, fires blade beams and awakens the Legendary Swords (Sword of the Lake, Caliburn...). Other classes can learn his techniques through a Lesson.
screen.isekai_mahou.class_knight.go_alta: Ready! Click the Oath Altar with the offering in your inventory.
command.isekai_mahou.class_knight.unknow: Unknown sword. Use: caliburn, flame, storm, frost, dark or lake.
Unknown grade. Use: squire, runeguard, templar or runeking.
command.isekai_mahou.class_knight.status: Oath %2$s · rune strikes %3$s · sword kills %4$s · bosses %5$s · swords %6$s
message.isekai_mahou.class_knight.avalon: Avalon: beyond every wound for %s s.
message.isekai_mahou.class_knight.anti_m: Anti-Magic Stance: %s s — spells won't stick to you.
glyph.isekai_mahou.knight_strike_air.des: Knight FORM (Wind; homage to the knight king's "Strike Air"). You release at once the wind barrier that hides your blade: a spiraling wind tunnel runs 16 blocks ahead (Accelerate +3) with a 1.8 radius (Expand +); every creature in its path takes the effects once and is hurled away. Then the wind wraps the sword again: INVISIBLE AIR for 20 s — the blade vanishes from sight (yours and others'), +2 damage, +1 reach and blows that push. Split = parallel tunnels. Can be a stage. Unlock: Oath I.
glyph.isekai_mahou.knight_anti_magic.des: Knight EFFECT (homage to the manaless boy with the black swords). The blade is coated in anti-magic. On an enemy: cuts for 8 (×1.5 against anyone with blessings or a magical creature) and NULLIFIES their magic — strips every blessing, Avalon and Aegis plates, interrupts players' casting and Silences for 3 s (Extend +). On yourself (Self): Anti-Magic Stance for 6 s — spell damage −75%%, curses are removed at once and enemy projectiles that come close are cut in mid-air. Unlock: Oath II.
glyph.isekai_mahou.knight_caliburn_strik: Knight EFFECT (Light). The golden blade of the stone falls upon the target: 9 damage (×1.4 with Caliburn or the Lake Sword in hand). The selection blesses its wielder: you gain 4 hearts of Absorption for 10 s (Extend +) and allies within 4 blocks of the target gain Regeneration for 3 s. Unlock: feat — awaken Caliburn at the Oath Altar.
glyph.isekai_mahou.knight_balmung.desc: Knight FORM (Light, Circle 5; homage to Gram/Balmung, the sword that slew the dragon). The blade releases the glow of twilight in a 140° FAN of 12 blocks (Expand +) that sweeps the field in 5 waves: every enemy in the fan takes the effects once. DRAGON SLAYER: dragons, serpents and wyverns take the effects at 175%% power; bosses, 135%%. Split = more sweeps. Can be a stage. Unlock: Oath IV.
glyph.isekai_mahou.knight_avalon.desc: Knight EFFECT (Light, beneficial, Circle 6). The sheath of the king's sword opens into a thousand motes of light and sets the target (you with Self, or allies) apart from the world for 4 s (Extend +; ×1.5 with the Lake Sword in hand): NEARLY INVULNERABLE — only the void gets through. Instantly heals 25%% of max health (× power, up to 40%%), removes curses, puts out fire and grants Regeneration II for 6 s. Unlock: feat — awaken the Lake Sword.
